Then \(t_\ell\in L^1(\gamma_O)\), \(t_\ell p_O\in L^1(dx)\), and \(\int t_\ell\,d\gamma_O=\int t_\ell p_O\,dx\) for every \(O\). The signed expectation is absolutely integrable under \(\mu\), and its average is the displayed formula, with \(U=O_{11}\). The endpoint \(\ell=0\) is included; half-dimension powers use real division. Integrability and density transport are conclusions, with no extra premise. Conditioned target mixtures and the total-variation interpretation remain open.

blind_reconstruction.text:
For every natural number n at least 3, every real number κ at least 4, and every nonnegative real number ℓ, consider the full real orthogonal group O(n), including both determinant signs, with its normalized Haar probability measure H. For O in this group set U(O)=O₀₀, a(O)=κ+1+4ℓ−(κ−1)U(O), and A(O)=((κ+1)/2)I−((κ−1)/4)(O+Oᵀ). On Euclidean Rⁿ let t(x)=exp(−ℓ‖x‖²), let γ(O) be the existing centered multivariate Gaussian measure with covariance A(O)⁻¹, and set p(O,x)=sqrt(det A(O))/(2π)^(n/2) times exp(−xᵀA(O)x/2). The matrix A(O) is positive definite in the stated parameter range, and all dimension-half exponents use real division.
For every O, t is absolutely integrable with respect to γ(O), the function x↦t(x)p(O,x) is absolutely integrable with respect to canonical Euclidean volume, and the integral of t under γ(O) equals the volume integral of t(x)p(O,x). Moreover O↦det(O) times the integral of t under γ(O) is absolutely integrable with respect to H, and its Haar integral is exactly
[ (−1)^(n−1)(sqrt(κ)−1)^(n−1) / 2^(n/2) ] times the Haar integral over O(n) of [ ((sqrt(κ)+1)U(O)−(sqrt(κ)−1)) / a(O)^(n/2) ].
All integrability claims and the equality between Gaussian and volume integrals are conclusions, not additional hypotheses; the equality for the Gaussian and volume integrals holds for every O, not merely almost everywhere. The outer measure is normalized Haar measure on the full orthogonal group, and the norm and volume are the true Euclidean ones.

/-!
# Actual signed Gaussian test expectation through Eq21

Zhou--Suzuki arXiv:2610.20492v1, Appendix B.2.2 H definition through Eq21.
Bounded-test Gaussian L1, weighted-volume L1, exact density transport and outer
signed Haar L1 are produced internally using identical compiled parents.
Conditioned target mixtures, H-to-TV, Poisson and main bounds remain separate.
-/

open Matrix MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantFamily
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianLawDensity
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.MixtureFubini

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianExpectation

theorem actual_gaussian_transform {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
            (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    (∀ O, Integrable t (γ O) ∧ Integrable (fun x => t x * p O x) volume ∧
      (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) = ∫ x, t x * p O x) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O)) (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) /
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) /
            (a O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
  classical
  let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
  let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
  let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
  let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
    fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
        Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
          (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
  let t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
  let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
    fun O => multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
      (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
  have htcont : Continuous t := by dsimp [t]; fun_prop
  have htbound (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : ‖t x‖ ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hℓ) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hp0 (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
      0 ≤ p O x := by dsimp [p]; positivity
  have hpmeas (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
      Measurable (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (p O x)) := by dsimp [p]; fun_prop
  have hfinite (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))),
        ENNReal.ofReal (p O x) < ⊤ := Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hpoint (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
      Integrable t (γ O) ∧ Integrable (fun x => t x * p O x) volume ∧
        (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) = ∫ x, t x * p O x := by
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure (γ O) := by dsimp [γ]; infer_instance
    have htL : Integrable t (γ O) :=
      (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' htcont.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall htbound)
    have hd : γ O = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (p O x)) :=
      gaussian_law_eq_density hn hκ O
    have htd : Integrable t (volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (p O x))) := by
      rw [← hd]
      exact htL
    have hw := (integrable_withDensity_iff (hpmeas O) (hfinite O)).mp htd
    have hw' : Integrable (fun x => t x * p O x) volume := by
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hp0 O _)] using hw
    refine ⟨htL, hw', ?_⟩
    rw [hd, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (hpmeas O) (hfinite O)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      change (ENNReal.ofReal (p O x)).toReal * t x = t x * p O x
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hp0 O x), mul_comm]
  have hlit := literal_mixture_transform hn hκ hℓ
  have hjoint : Integrable
      (fun z : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
        (z.1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (t z.2 * p z.1 z.2))
      ((orthogonalHaar n).prod volume) := hlit.1
  have houter : Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O)) (orthogonalHaar n) := by
    have hi := hjoint.integral_prod_left
    apply hi.congr
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun O => by
      change (∫ x, (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (t x * p O x)) =
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O)
      rw [integral_const_mul, (hpoint O).2.2]
  refine ⟨hpoint, houter, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x * p O x)
          ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun O => by
        change (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) =
          (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x * p O x)
        rw [(hpoint O).2.2]
    _ = _ := hlit.2.2

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianExpectation

steps.title: Bound the test
steps.text: Continuity and \(0<t_\ell\le1\) give absolute integrability under every Gaussian probability measure. This also covers \(\ell=0\).
steps.lean: The proof uses actual multivariateGaussian probability, continuity and an explicit norm bound; Gaussian test integrability is produced internally.

steps.title: Identify the density
steps.text: The existing density theorem identifies the actual law \(\gamma_O\) with the nonnegative, measurable density \(p_O\) relative to Euclidean volume. All source conditions are unchanged.
steps.lean: The proof actually calls GaussianLawDensity.gaussian_law_eq_density hn hκ O. Positivity and measurability are verified for the unchanged explicit p_O; no substitute Gaussian constructor is introduced.

steps.title: Transport the integral
steps.text: Transport absolute integrability and the expectation through that density identity. Both spatial integrals below are absolutely integrable.
steps.lean: The proof uses integrable_withDensity_iff and integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul, with internal measurable/finite/nonnegative density proofs. ENNReal.ofReal and multiplication order are simplified exactly.

steps.title: Control the outer expectation
steps.text: The compiled Fubini result gives joint integrability under \(\mu\otimes dx\). Integrating the spatial variable and using the pointwise identity gives absolute Haar integrability of the signed expectation.
steps.lean: The proof consumes the exact literal_mixture_transform joint-L1 conclusion and actual Integrable.integral_prod_left, then pointwise congruence and integral_const_mul. No unproved family-measurability premise is supplied.

steps.title: Apply the evaluated transform
steps.text: The pointwise density identity turns \(H_\gamma\) into the literal transform \(H_{\mathrm{lit}}\). Apply its already evaluated formula. The relation to conditioned mixtures and total variation is a later step.
steps.lean: The final composition uses the same pointwise expectation transport and exact equality projection of MixtureFubini.literal_mixture_transform hn hκ hℓ. No Gaussian/B6/Fubini proof is copied, and no TV or Poisson conclusion is asserted.
